2609.10335.title: From Symbolic Perception to Logical Deduction: A Framework for Guiding Language Models in Geometric Reasoning
2609.10335.paper_summary: Plane geometry remains a significant challenge in AI, requiring the integration of visual perception and mathematical reasoning. While Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) naturally handle visuo-linguistic inputs, they are often computationally intensive and opaque. We demonstrate that a pure Large Language Model (LLM), when equipped with specialized modules, can rival state-of-the-art LMMs on complex geometry problems. Our framework integrates a Geometric Vision Parser, which translates diagrams into symbolic form, with a Symbolic Solver that performs formal deductions, thereby mitigating hallucinations and promoting interpretable reasoning. To enable rigorous evaluation, we curate a benchmark of challenging problems from the 2025 Chinese Zhongkao examinations, ensuring data novelty and testing deeper deductive skills. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves performance comparable to Gemini 2.5 Pro while delivering clearer, human-like solutions.
2609.10335.paper_summary_zh: 平面幾何在人工智慧中仍然是一個重大挑戰，需要整合視覺感知和數學推理。雖然大型多模態模型（LMMs）自然能處理視覺語言輸入，但它們通常計算密集且不透明。我們展示了一個純大型語言模型（LLM），當配備專門模組時，可以在複雜的幾何問題上與最先進的LMMs相媲美。我們的框架整合了一個幾何視覺解析器，將圖表轉換為符號形式，與一個進行形式推理的符號求解器相結合，從而減輕幻覺並促進可解釋的推理。為了進行嚴謹的評估，我們策劃了一個來自2025年中國中考考試的挑戰性問題基準，確保數據的新穎性並測試更深層的推理技能。實驗表明，我們的方法在性能上可與Gemini 2.5 Pro相媲美，同時提供更清晰、類似人類的解決方案。
